name: Sao
body:
SAO
CR 10

A massive figure looms with contained power, with defined physique shaped by imposing strength. A chiseled visage frames ember-lit eyes that glow and sparkle with golden warmth.

XP 9,600
NG Huge humanoid (giant)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 20 (+3 armor, +4 Dex, +9 natural, –2 size)
hp 136 (13d8+78)
Fort +11, Ref +9, Will +13

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee mwk greatsword +18/+13 (4d6+15/19–20) or 2 slams +17 (1d8+10)
Ranged mwk composite longbow +12/+7 (3d6+10/×3 plus push)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks forceful archer, overwhelming might

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 19, Con 22, Int 15, Wis 18, Cha 17
Base Atk +9; CMB +21 (+23 bull rush); CMD 35 (37 vs. bull rush)
Feats Awesome Blow, Bullseye Shotisg, Far Shot, Improved Bull Rush, Point-Blank Shot, Power Attack, Precise Shot
Skills Climb +20, Craft (any one) +12, Knowledge (any one) +12, Perception +17, Perform (any one) +12, Sense Motive +17, Swim +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Swim
Languages Common, Giant
SQ peerless strength

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Forceful Archer (Ex)

When a sao makes a ranged attack with a bow, they can choose to push the target back. If the attack hits a Largesized or smaller creature, the creature is pushed back 10 feet, as per the Push universal monster ability. Sao hunters often combine this with Bullseye Shot which lets them spend a move action to gain a +4 bonus on their next ranged attack roll before the end of their turn.

Overwhelming Might (Ex)

When making a full attack, if a sao hits the same target with two melee attacks, the target must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round by the barrage of blows. The sao can only use this ability once per round. The DC is equal to 10 + the sao’s base attack bonus.

Peerless Strength (Ex)

A sao gains a +4 racial bonus on Strength ability checks and Strength-based skill checks. A sao also treats their Strength score as 8 higher than normal when determining carrying capacity.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm forests
Treasure standard (masterwork hide shirt, masterwork greatsword, masterwork composite longbow [+10 Str ] with 20 arrows, other treasure)

The Sao are a species of giant known for their massive size, formidable strength, and generous spirit. They have bright, glowing eyes that sparkle with inner amusement, especially when sharing their knowledge with the smaller peoples of their region. The sao view humans, elves, and other smaller folk as their “little siblings”. They delight in sharing their culture, artifice, and knowledge with others, but there is always an air of prideful superiority to their generosity.

The Sao are a small but advanced civilization. They delight in art, music, science, history, and other forms of learning.

Familial groups form around complementary aptitudes, sao often select a partner whose talents complement and balance their own, creating household units that are wellrounded and culturally vibrant. They are renowned as archers and woodcutters, noted for their care in tending the land, especially the trees. They harvest and consume similar foods to other humanoids, just on a much grander scale.

Sao are both highly civilized and highly competitive. While they enjoy debates and games of strategy, they love nothing more than pitting their physical prowess against other beings. They love arm wrestling, grappling, weight lifting, and other contests involving physical strength. They do try, though not always successfully, to avoid accidentally injuring smaller beings who choose to participate.

Although fluent in the Giant language, sao have limited contact with other giants, most of whom they view as barbaric. Adult sao are roughly twenty feet tall and weigh around 5,000 pounds.
